description: This file defines a JavaScript class CKEDITOR.htmlParser for parsing HTML text, including handling tags, comments, CDATA sections, and text nodes. It provides overridable callback functions for different HTML components during parsing.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser
classes.description: A class for parsing HTML strings, with callback methods for handling tags, comments, CDATA, and text.
